description:
WWDC 2025 unveiled Apple’s first universal design language across all of its platforms, and it’s called Apple’s Liquid Glass Design. 

Inspired by visionOS, Liquid Glass is layered throughout the system and features rounded corners that have been matched to the curved screens of the devices. It behaves just like glass in the real world and morphs when you need more options or move between views.
